text:
zoe_m: Heads up from support: a customer reported audit log wording was confusing during a compliance review. They saw `Encrypted: customer` and asked for clarification. Can we update copy so reviewers won't misinterpret?

kai_r: Agreed. We should standardize all visible strings to `Customer-managed KMS` or `Platform-managed KMS`. Avoid `customer` alone.

omar_b: FE note: the audit rows are narrow. Long strings break layout. We can show short label `Customer-managed KMS` and expand full sentence in tooltip / aria-label. Also need to ensure the audit CSV export uses the longer explicit wording.

rhea_s: Backend will add `kms_type` and `kms_readable` to audit events. `kms_readable` will contain the full human sentence for exports. That avoids FE having to compile long strings.

mags_a: Accessibility: tooltip text must be accessible via keyboard and have `role="tooltip"` with `aria-describedby` on the chip. And avoid color-only indicators for key ownership.

zoe_m: Let's also fix the retention modal header. Support suggested `Retention (data residency)` which they think is clearer than the current label. Kai, can you propose final copy?

kai_r: Proposed strings: header: `Retention (data residency)`, helptext: `Controls how long generated data is kept for the selected region. This applies to model outputs and logs.` toast: `Saved retention — eu-central (14 days)`. KMS short label: `Customer-managed KMS` (tooltip: `Encrypted with a key your organization controls.`)

omar_b: I'll implement short label + tooltip + aria, plus export usage of `kms_readable`. Also will increase toast display to 8s for verbose messages.

mags_a: I will run accessibility smoke tests once the PR is open. Also remind: toasts should not auto-dismiss if they contain `View` action and must be keyboard-focusable.

zoe_m: Thanks. Action items: Omar (PR), Rhea (audit schema), Kai (final copy), Mags (a11y review). ci-bot: run unit tests on PR.

ci-bot: tests queued for run on branch `fix/audit-kms-copy` (omar_b).
